new_value: Defined the attestation-cert revocation model in spec/appendix-x509-cert-profile.md §6 'Revocation model' (3 paragraphs) + §8 step 2 extension. Content: (a) no online revocation (CRL/OCSP already forbidden §1) — revocation is by supersession under the §6 freshness-ordering rule; (b) supersession is per-verifier-on-presentment — a censoring radio adversary prolongs the prior chain's honored window; (c) not-yet-valid chains MUST NOT be honored or displace a valid cached chain; expired cached chains MUST NOT be honored; (d) per-subject-key freshness floor (greatest leaf notBefore ever cached) gates DISPLACEMENT only — cached chain honored regardless; floor generalizes the base freshness rule so replayed older-but-still-valid chains can't roll back after the newer chain expires; floor SHOULD persist across restarts (NVM-less consequence stated); floor MAY sunset at floor date + 825-day max validity; expired-chain bodies MAY be reclaimed once the floor is recorded, current chain MUST NOT be dropped; (e) compromised subject key is NOT supersession-revocable (re-key = new identity) — retire out-of-band, 200-day RECOMMENDED validity bounds exposure. The bead's premise was partially stale (397-day validity → now 200d/825d; CRL/OCSP now forbidden; freshness replacement defined). 3x codereview + convergence (kimi-k3 via opencode): pass1 correctness = 2 findings (compromised-key displacement error; discard reopens rollback) fixed; pass2 security = 3 findings (floor enforcement not mandated; body-drop scope; supersession censorship) fixed; pass3 edge = 4 findings (floor gates cached-chain honoring; floor missing from §8; permanent floor growth; not-yet-valid displacement) fixed; convergence pass = opencode timed out x2, performed by worker model: all 9 findings verified fixed, cross-refs and tie-rule consistent, PASS.
